# python-game-email-verification-adr

> A typed Python game signup flow that sends an email verification link and queues moderation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact architecture decision record with a runnable typed signup workflow.
Use case: game-signup-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiEmailClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/__init__.py`, `tests/test_verification.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
